files.title: File:Postcard of the “Wishing Well” in Perry’s Cave, Put-In-Bay, Ohio.jpg
files.author: Unknown authorUnknown author
files.caption: The discovery of Perry’s Cave in 1813 on South Bass Island (aka Put-In-Bay) is credited to Commodore Oliver Hazard Perry, who supposedly treated ill sailors with fresh water from inside the cave. For decades after, sightseers would drink water from the cave’s “Wishing Well.”
